english.title: Cause use of a goods vehicle without mirrors - maximum gross weight exceeding 3500 kg

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), of a maximum gross weight exceeding 3.5 tonnes , which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY MISSING MIRROR(S)..) as specified in item 3 of the table to regulation 33 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 33(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording does not apply to an agricultural motor vehicle or to one which is not driven at more than 20 mph, or to a vehicle governed by item 4 (see offence wording H3331).
(ii) Instead of complying with regulation 33(1)-(4) a vehicle may comply with the relevant Community Directive referred to in regulation 33(5).
(iii) This offence wording applies to goods vehicles first used on or after 1.4.83. Items 6 and 7 of the table to regulation 33 govern goods vehicles in use before 1.4.83.
(iv) Statement of Facts applies - see end of document for wording.
(vi) See also offence wordings: H3325 and H3330.
